mapper.select: SELECT fo_num AS foNum, fo_name AS foName, fo_base_gram AS foBaseGram, fo_kcal AS foKcal, fo_carbs AS foCarbs, fo_protein AS foProtein, fo_fat AS foFat, fo_natrium AS foNatrium, fo_type AS foType FROM food ORDER BY fo_name

SELECT fo_num AS foNum, fo_name AS foName, fo_base_gram AS foBaseGram, fo_kcal AS foKcal, fo_carbs AS foCarbs, fo_protein AS foProtein, fo_fat AS foFat, fo_natrium AS foNatrium, fo_type AS foType FROM food WHERE fo_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY fo_name

SELECT fo_num AS foNum, fo_name AS foName, fo_base_gram AS foBaseGram, fo_kcal AS foKcal, fo_carbs AS foCarbs, fo_protein AS foProtein, fo_fat AS foFat, fo_natrium AS foNatrium, fo_type AS foType FROM food WHERE fo_num = #{foNum}

SELECT fo_num AS foNum, fo_name AS foName, fo_kcal AS foKcal, fo_carbs AS foCarbs, fo_protein AS foProtein, fo_fat AS foFat, fo_natrium AS foNatrium FROM food WHERE fo_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{foodName}, '%')
